text:
maria: alerting  billing spike: ~22 requests attributed to `org:unknown` in the last 30m. pattern points to proxy-svc traffic coming through auth-exchange. anyone on call?

joel: i'm on it. quick check: any recent change to exchange token minting or claim normalization?

dan: morning. yesterday we merged a small hardening change to strip resource-scoped claims from proxy tokens for downstream least-privilege. that was supposed to be safe.

maria: here's a sanitized trace for one of the requests:
```
POST /v1/complete 200
Auth: Bearer ptk-...
Received headers: X-Forwarded-For: 10.12.34.56, X-Caller-Service: proxy-svc
service auth: resolved principal=sa-321 org=org-789 project=
```
(project empty)

sara: ah. quota service expects `origin_project` in the auth context to attribute usage. if missing we currently fall back to `org` but somewhere our fallback ended up mapping to `org:unknown` which is puzzling.

joel: do we have exchange logs for the same request?

dan: pulled one:
```
[2026-03-22T09:11:02Z] exchange: incoming token=sa-321 path=proxy-svc->exchange
[2026-03-22T09:11:02Z] exchange: validated subject=sa-321 claims={"org":"org-789","project":"proj-555"}
[2026-03-22T09:11:02Z] exchange: minted token=ptk-444 claims={"org":"org-789"}
```
project claim missing on minted token.

maria: so the original SA had project claim but exchange omitted it intentionally (policy). fine, but we must ensure attribution survives proxying.

dan: options: 1) exchange includes project claim in proxy token when safe, 2) exchange emits an `X-Origin-Project` header on proxied requests and telemetry picks it up, 3) attach an immutable request-metadata envelope that quota/telemetry reads.

sara: preference for header approach for minimal blast radius. header can be checked by quota service and trimmed at edge if necessary. downside: need to make sure downstream services trust the header only if it comes from exchange (we can sign it or set a header signature).

joel: alternative: include a signed metadata header like `X-Auth-Metadata: base64(sig+json)` so downstream can verify the signature. that avoids leaking claims in JWTs.

dan: true. small implementation plan: exchange will do an authoritative lookup against projects registry (read-only cache) to confirm the SA is actually allowed for that project. if yes, set signed header and DON'T copy project into raw claims unless caller is same-identity (to avoid privilege escalation).

maria: also we should update telemetry mapping priority to prefer (1) signed header `X-Auth-Metadata.project`, (2) token.claims.project, (3) request.header `X-Org-Project`, (4) org fallback. and emit a sampling debug tag when project missing.

sara: i'll push telemetry change and add an alert rule: if `org:unknown` attribution rate increases by >5x relative to baseline during canary, page oncall.

joel: rollout plan: patch exchange + signed header support -> canary alpha-2 at 1% -> monitor quota attribution, billing dashboards, quota-enforcement logs for 48h -> promote. rollback if unknown-attribution increases or any quota denial regressions.

dan: i'll draft PR for exchange: project registry check + create signed metadata header `X-Auth-Meta`. will include unit tests for header signing and verification.

maria: i'll update dashboards: add a small panel that shows attribution source (signed_header vs claim vs unknown) and count of events. also add a compare chart pre/post-canary.

sara: adding playbook snippet: if we see signed header present but quota still maps to org:unknown, check quota-service verification logs (auth.verify_id header) and the signature secret rotation.

infra-bot: scheduled deploy: auth-exchange v2.42 -> cluster alpha-2 at 2026-03-22T11:00:00Z :rocket:

maria: created GH issue #4901 for attribution gap + PRs linked there.

infra-bot: PR #4924 (exchange: add signed metadata header) opened by @dan :github:

infra-bot: CI passed for #4924 :white_check_mark:

joel: thanks team. i'll run the canary and validate the attribution source panel. will report back in ~6h. :+1:

maria: canary started, metrics look clean so far (first 30m). continued monitoring.

sara: thanks — filing a short UX note for console: when attribution is unknown, show a tooltip explaining it may be due to proxy token strip policies and link to the attribution troubleshooting doc.

joel: perfect. syncing tomorrow AM if anything unexpected pops up.
